answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can release earnings through a slow escrow: new identities receive only a velvet trickle of income at first, while a random audit samples their work like a pearl diver checking each catch. The audit result becomes a public signal of trustworthiness, and only identities with a clean audit history unlock full payouts. Creating many fake identities therefore earns almost nothing, because each one must survive the same slow release and random checks before it can profit.
